frozen_manifest_unit.title: PELDOR/DEER-smFRET comparison under different physical states
frozen_manifest_unit.challenge_intent: Test that a valuable cross-method paper does not receive a matched-condition or independent-validation label when its stated physical states differ.

source_first_pass_a.scientific_question: Can PELDOR/DEER and smFRET be labeled condition-matched or independently validating when the paper reports different physical sample states?

source_identity_and_locators.citation: Peter et al. (2022), Cross-validation of distance measurements in proteins by PELDOR/DEER and single-molecule FRET, Nature Communications 13:4396.

exact_pdf_locators.scope: four proteins, inter-probe distance comparison, and named technique-specific inconsistencies.

exact_pdf_locators.locator: PDF p. 2, Figure 1 caption and adjacent text
exact_pdf_locators.scope: PELDOR/DEER and smFRET workflows and representation differences.
different sample amount and physical-state conditions for the two methods.

source_objects.native_observable: PELDOR/DEER distance distributions and smFRET efficiency/distance representations from labeled proteins.
source_objects.estimand: Inter-probe distances and conformational-change comparisons across the two methods.
source_objects.statistical_unit: Double-cysteine variants of four proteins measured with each method in the stated protocols.
source_objects.temporal_or_ensemble_semantics: The methods differ in physical-state context, including frozen solution versus liquid solution conditions stated in Table 1.
source_objects.transformations_and_model_assumptions: Both techniques involve probe-specific distance inference and comparisons to structural-model predictions.
source_objects.uncertainty_or_reliability_boundaries: Named technique-specific inconsistencies include cryoprotectant and label-protein effects.

atomic_source_supported_statements.statement: The abstract compares PELDOR/DEER and smFRET distance measurements across four proteins and reports technique-specific inconsistencies.
Table 1 contrasts usual PELDOR/DEER frozen-solution conditions with liquid-solution or cell-culture smFRET conditions.

source_first_pass_a.source_relationship: This is a cross-modal edge test. The paper's value as a comparison study does not remove the stated physical-state difference.
source_first_pass_a.maximum_source_supported_wording: The source supports recording a cross-method comparison and its stated condition difference; it does not support a matched-condition label for this edge.
forbidden_generalizations: Call the methods condition-matched despite the stated physical-state difference.
Call one technique an independent validation of the other without separately declared lineage/shared-error facts.
missing_information: A complete project edge lineage and shared-error assessment are not extracted.
possible_reusable_review_obligations: Keep validation independence separate from cross-method agreement.
source_first_pass_a.authority_boundary: Primary-source bounded record only; it does not establish annotation truth, source-science approval, Rule validity, or scientific support.
